last.minutes: We decide to maintain our current spot allocations in BTC and SOL without any adjustments, preserving our cash buffer to avoid unnecessary transaction fees and tax friction during this neutral consolidation phase. In the futures book, we continue to hold our NEAR long at 2x leverage to capitalize on its positive momentum and recent ecosystem security recovery, while keeping a disciplined stop-loss to protect against potential crowded long flushes. This balanced approach prioritizes capital preservation while keeping selective exposure to high-conviction setups.

futures.why: We hold our profitable NEAR long to ride its positive fundamental momentum following the successful recovery of ecosystem funds.

spot.why: Holding our core BTC position preserves capital and avoids high transaction costs during this neutral market consolidation.
SOL remains a strong major asset that we hold to minimize churn and avoid tax drag while the market consolidates.

lessons.text: Holding cash and established market leaders during a range-bound neutral regime is a valid tactical decision that protects the portfolio from high transaction fees and non-deductible tax drag.
Holding core positions and resisting the urge to overtrade in a choppy, tax-heavy regime preserves capital and prevents unnecessary fee erosion.
Holding core positions and maintaining cash during a neutral, range-bound regime protects capital from heavy transaction fees and non-deductible tax drag.
In a neutral regime, the combined drag of transaction fees and non-deductible taxes makes holding cash and core majors more effective than frequent altcoin rotation.
Allowing a winning futures trade with fundamental momentum to run while keeping spot book churn minimal is the most effective approach in a neutral market with high tax friction.
In a neutral and consolidating market, preserving capital by holding core majors and maintaining a substantial cash buffer is far more effective than chasing volatile altcoin momentum.
